faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Sugar Institute (NSI) for filling up essential research and technical positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NSI?
faq.answer: NSI has advertised for the post of Foreman (Electrical) under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Foreman (Electrical) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NSI Foreman Recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to send their physical application forms to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for Foreman (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three years Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognised Institute or Board along with required work experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is prior experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have two years of experience working in a factory or workshop of a Government organisation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for NSI Foreman (Electrical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is not exceeding 56 years as per the deputation terms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary scale for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Level-6, Cell-1, ranging from Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400/- as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the Senior Administrative Officer, National Sugar Institute, Kalyanpur, Kanpur-208017 within the stipulated timeframe.
